base_cells.coverage: every observer completes every base cell

capacity_rule: No width receives PASS/FAIL or a capacity until observer-level uncertainty, catch criteria, and held-out floor calibration are complete.

catch_trials.design: large commanded solid separations at 3 CSS px

floor_calibration.allocation: sealed before the run and excluded from proxy/model tuning
floor_calibration.method: fit threshold only on held-out trial responses after protocol lock

assignment_formula.correct_answer_side: left when (observer_index + repeat_index + base_cell_index) mod 2 = 0; right otherwise

fractional_factors.balance_at_15_observers: for each base cell and repeat, the 15 observers cover every one of the 3 style x 5 orientation combinations exactly once; repeat two covers each combination once again, and answer side swaps across repeats
fractional_factors.base_cell_order: canonical Cartesian order: pair, then state, background, and width_css_px

observers.balance_basis: least common multiple of 3 styles and 5 orientations

power_analysis_before_run.decision_rule: increase observer count in multiples of 15 if the target power or precision is not met; never reduce below 15
power_analysis_before_run.method: simulation-based power and interval-width analysis for the preregistered hierarchical 2AFC model using design-only effect-size scenarios
power_analysis_before_run.timing: after protocol lock and before recruitment or response collection

session_plan.timing_basis: 400 total trials budgeted at no more than 5 seconds average each, plus adaptation and three required rests

task: A target line segment is shown in a chart and two labeled legend samples are offered; choose which legend identity matches the target.
